entries.value: "Tiny dependency-free leaf crate for base-studio-code (#1646) — the ONE definition of home-dir resolution, the `~/.base-studio-code` base dir, epoch clocks (secs/ms), and the epoch-ms↔ISO-8601 civil-date pair. Shared by the desktop app and every `bsc-*` CLI so they all resolve the same on-disk store."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# Leaf crate: std only, no dependencies, so any CLI can pull it in for free.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # TESTS ONLY — a dev-dependency is not propagated to anything that links this crate, so the
# "no dependencies" property above is unchanged for every consumer. `pane_id` is proved against
# `src/app/console/paneIdentity.fixtures.json`, a fixture GENERATED from the TypeScript it was ported
# from, and hand-rolling a JSON reader to avoid this line would reintroduce exactly the kind of
# second parser the port exists to remove.
# THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
